name: Museum of the Waxhaws
unique: A regional museum on the Waxhaw settlement, with Native American artifacts, pioneer tools and the story of Andrew Jackson's birthplace in the border country.
buzz: Small and volunteer run, with more depth than expected on the Scotch Irish settlement. Call ahead.

name: Treehouse Vineyards
unique: A winery with two rentable treehouses in the oaks and a tasting room built around them, plus muscadine and fruit wines made on the property.
buzz: The treehouses are the gimmick and the tasting is friendly. Book the treehouse months ahead for a weekend.

name: Cane Creek Park
unique: A county park around a 350 acre lake with a beach, boat rentals, trails and campsites, south of Charlotte.
buzz: The beach and paddle boats are the summer draw. Quiet on weekdays and cheap.

name: Hickory Museum of Art
unique: A free museum with a strong collection of American art, studio glass and folk art, in a converted post office downtown.
buzz: Free and surprisingly good for a mill town, with a glass collection that connects to the region's craft schools.

name: Catawba Science Center
unique: A hands on science museum with a freshwater aquarium, a planetarium and a saltwater touch tank, in the old Hickory post office.
buzz: Good for kids under twelve, with enough live animals to hold attention. The planetarium is a bonus.

name: Bunker Hill Covered Bridge
unique: One of the last two remaining covered bridges in North Carolina, with a rare lattice truss designed by a bridge engineer, standing in a quiet meadow.
buzz: A five minute stop that rewards anyone who likes old structures. The truss is the interesting part.

name: Salisbury Historic District
unique: A grid of 18th and 19th century houses, churches and a restored depot, with a self guided walking tour and a farmers market on the square.
buzz: The architecture is the draw and the town is compact. Pick up the tour map at the visitor center.

name: Rowan Museum
unique: A county museum in the 1854 courthouse, with Civil War rooms, Native American artifacts and the story of Salisbury's Confederate prison.
buzz: The prison history is the heavy part and the exhibits do not soften it. Small and cheap.

name: Salisbury National Cemetery
unique: A national cemetery holding Union soldiers who died in the Salisbury prison, with rows of markers and a monument, beside the historic district.
buzz: Quiet and sobering, with the scale of the prison deaths made visible. A short, respectful stop.

name: Tweetsie Railroad
unique: A Wild West theme park built around a narrow gauge steam railroad that climbs a mountain, with staged train robberies, a chairlift and amusement rides.
buzz: The train robbery show is the reason and kids love it. It is old fashioned in a way that works for young families.

name: Blowing Rock
unique: A cliff edge rock where the wind blows upward hard enough to return a thrown hat, with a view over the John's River gorge and the Blue Ridge.
buzz: The hat trick is the photo and the view is real. The park is small, so pair it with the town.

name: Mast General Store, Valle Crucis
unique: The original 1883 general store in a mountain valley, with wooden floors, a potbelly stove, barrels of candy and overalls hanging from the ceiling.
buzz: It is a store, but the building and the setting are the attraction. The candy counter is the kid bribe.

name: Morrow Mountain State Park
unique: A CCC park on a ancient volcanic ridge above Lake Tillery, with a summit trail, a pool, camping and a museum of the Uwharrie range.
buzz: The summit view is the payoff and the trails are well built. Less crowded than the Blue Ridge parks.

name: North Carolina Aviation Museum
unique: A hangar museum with restored military and civilian aircraft, engines and memorabilia, on a small town airfield.
buzz: The planes are close enough to touch and the volunteers flew some of them. Check flying days.

name: Lake Lure
unique: A mountain lake ringed by cliffs and the Hickory Nut Gorge, with a public beach, boat tours and the film locations of Dirty Dancing.
buzz: The lake is the draw and the beach is small but scenic. Boat tours sell out in summer.

name: Rutherfordton Historic District
unique: A small grid of 19th century houses, a courthouse and churches around a square, with a gold rush history and a Revolutionary War route.
buzz: Quiet and well kept, a good leg stretch on the way to Lake Lure. The old jail is the curiosity.
